meta.title: 소리상회 100년
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (소리상회, a music shop on the same corner for a hundred years, 1925 to 2025 (fictional shop)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 소리상회, a music shop on the same corner for a hundred years, 1925 to 2025 (fictional shop)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: One palette per era on one dark-wood frame #1E160E: 1925 sepia browns, 1955 hand-tinted teal and tomato on cream, 1975 burnt orange and brown with bulb yellow, 1995 night violet with a pink neon #FF4FC3, 2025 off-white with ink #1E2A36 and green #2E7D6A.
rationale.type: One face per era through the five font roles: Song Myung (1925, and the frame), Yeon Sung (1955), Do Hyeon (1975), Black Han Sans (1995), Pretendard (2025 and the small print).
rationale.motion: The same shopfront in the same place five times: the camera eases in, the year rolls up from the last era like an odometer, the window comes alive in its own way (a record turning under a horn, a radio needle and waves, marquee bulbs chasing and LPs spinning, a neon sign flickering on and a CD sheen, a waveform on a tablet); the tree beside the shop grows from era to era.
rationale.sound: One tempo, 112 BPM in C major, under a quiet bed (pad, pluck, bass, light drums); each era brings its own recorded riff on the beat (VCSL and VSCO 2 CE, CC0): ragtime upright piano, trumpet stabs, strummed guitar, a glassy synth, a kalimba.
rationale.visuals: All code: the shop is one drawing with per-era parameters (sign shape and face, awning, wall courses, window display) and per-era surfaces drawn over the frame (film grain, scratches, flicker and an iris; halftone; a light leak; scanlines and a neon street).
rationale.narration: Possible: a line per era, but the years carry it.
